'''2013 Worlds Day 2 John Anderson DS Contract Killers''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[John Anderson]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Contract Killers / Feared Throughout The Galaxy|VB8-D-contractkillers-pre.gif}}
* '''Username:''' puck71
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
